modules.name: Syzygy
modules.description: A polyphonic stereo oscillator that merges two distinctive voices, allowing you to fade, crossmodulate, wavefold and mix in pink/white noise for unique additive synth sounds.

modules.name: Super Wonk
modules.description: 16-channel phase-linked low frequency oscillator with the abiltiy to get wonky or morph into alignment.

modules.name: Envelope City
modules.description: An ultra-precise AD function/envelope generator with shapes that morph smoothly over 16-channels.

modules.name: Arrange XL
modules.description: 16-channel sequencer with ability to sample and record CV inputs.
